_note: USD per million tokens, keyed by the exact LLM_MODEL / JUDGE_MODEL string. Cost is reported as 'n/a' for any model not listed. Do not guess prices.
_local_models: Local Ollama models are priced at a shadow rate, not $0: the median per-token price across hosted providers serving the same open-weight model (input and output medians taken separately). It stands for what the same work would cost from a vendor, so local and API runs stay comparable. min/max give the provider range for sensitivity. Source: OpenRouter /api/v1/models/<id>/endpoints, retrieved 2026-10-25.
